snippet.title: Age of Enchantment - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Releases on 3/16/2026!

Play Age of Enchantment on Steam ➔ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3046020/Age_of_Enchantment/

Join the Discord ➔ https://discord.com/invite/BU2sWSnMjz
Press Kit ➔ https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1iX-TEEjgCW0FqVncSP5hf7AMqBHymyHq
Instagram ➔ https://www.instagram.com/psychic.monkey.studio/


Age of Enchantment is a tower defense deckbuilder where your towers are classes from D&D. Customize your loadout by selecting your starting towers, artifacts, and difficulty modifiers and create synergies as your build your deck out each run.
